Tara B: Quick Q — we have a small set of reviewers who missed the form cutoff due to a payroll freeze exception. Can we run a narrow late-submission window (48h) for those specific people only?
Mika H: Is this for documented payroll exceptions only or a broader ask? Need to avoid setting a precedent.
Tara B: Payroll exceptions only, documented by People Ops. Small list (3 people) — all have manager approvals.
Owen C: Ok if it's limited and managers confirm. Would prefer we tag these as 'late-exception' so calibrators know to treat carefully.
Tara B: Agreed. I propose: (1) allow 48h extension for listed employees only, (2) flag forms with "late-exception" tag, (3) reviewers can skip overflow assignment for these if they're already at cap.
Mika H: +1. Also add a short note to calibrators: these folks had payroll/legal reasons; please avoid penalizing timing in qualitative notes.
Juno (HR Bot): I can extend the form window per user list and add metadata tag "late-exception" to submissions. Please provide user IDs and manager approvals.
Tara B: Sending the list to Juno and DMing managers now. I'll post a brief announcement once Juno confirms the extensions applied.
Owen C: Thanks. Small and surgical is the right move.
Mika H: No objections. Thanks Tara.
Juno (HR Bot): Pending list; will apply extensions once approvals are attached.
